# Rubicon Med

> Strategic Roadmapping and due diligence advisory for medical device, diagnostics, and digital health companies.

Rubicon Med partners with executives and investors on technical, clinical, and R&D due diligence and product Roadmapping. Our IDEA framework helps teams de-risk decisions, validate competitive advantage, and build defensible plans before major investments.

- [Home](/): Overview of Rubicon Med's advisory services and IDEA Roadmapping framework.
- [About](/about): Leadership bio for Rob Miraglia and the firm's approach.
- [Services](/services): Due diligence, Roadmapping, and advisory engagement models.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on medical device strategy, due diligence, and Roadmapping.
